title: crinum exile
intro: Crinum exile, commonly known as the Tiger's Tail or Wild Garlic, is a plant species native to India and other parts of Asia. This plant is known for its bulbous base and long, grass-like leaves that grow from the base, and its flowers, which appear at the tip of a long, thin stem. The health benefits of Crinum exile include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and provide relief from digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its antispasmodic, anti-allergic, and diuretic properties.
